name: Posterior Shoulder Dislocation
definition: Posterior displacement of the humeral head, uncommon and frequently missed, often associated with seizures, electrical injury or trauma.

investigations.principle: Dedicated imaging is essential because AP radiographs can miss the diagnosis.
investigations.MRI: CT helps define fracture-dislocation; MRI is used later for soft-tissue injury.
investigations.radiographs: Axillary or scapular-Y views help establish diagnosis.

amber: Delayed or fracture-associated dislocations often require specialist operative management.
red: Urgent red-flag features override routine conservative or Ayurvedic pathways.

ayurvedaFramework.text: Amsa-sandhi displacement may be documented only after modern orthopedic diagnosis.

patientEducation.summary: Posterior displacement of the humeral head, uncommon and frequently missed, often associated with seizures, electrical injury or trauma.
patientEducation.urgent: Seek urgent assessment for acute/progressive neurological deficit, severe infection/systemic illness, major trauma, vascular compromise or other listed red flags.
